about: Background apps on Linux (Mint, Ubuntu, Debian) and the tier for each. safe_to_block: nothing in the system leans on it. block_not_disable: cut its network, keep it running. leave: switching it off can break something. Anything not listed is leave. match is an fnmatch pattern on the unit name, the autostart file name without .desktop, or the flatpak/snap id.

entries.why: Sends kernel crash signatures to kerneloops.org. Nothing on the system depends on it.
Ubuntu crash reporting. Crash files are still written locally without it.
Catches crashes to offer a bug report. Programs run the same without it.
Finds network printers on its own and adds them. Printers you already added keep working. It has had remote-code bugs (CVE-2024-47176).
Mobile broadband (3G/4G/5G) modems. Without such a modem nothing uses it.
Checks the live USB image at boot. Pointless on an installed system.
Ubuntu Pro subscription checks. Not needed without a Pro subscription.
Ubuntu Pro housekeeping after reboots. Not needed without a Pro subscription.
Firmware updates. Other tools talk to it, so keep it running; cutting its network stops it fetching firmware lists.
Finds printers, file shares and Warpinator peers on the local network. Other programs rely on it.
Bluetooth. Switching it off disconnects keyboards, mice and headsets.
Screen rotation and light sensors on convertibles.
Switches between the two graphics chips.
Printing itself.
Bans addresses that keep failing to log in. A protection, not bloat.
The firewall.
Confines programs. A protection, not bloat.
AgentalSec itself.
Downloads Ubuntu news for the login message. Nothing depends on it.
Refreshes the update count in the login message. The update manager still works.
Ubuntu Pro status checks. Not needed without a Pro subscription.
Sends crash reports on a schedule.
Fetches and installs security updates.
Checks for firmware security updates.
Keeps log files from filling the disk.
Cleans temporary files.
The welcome screen at login. Nothing depends on it.
System Reports tray icon. Reports can still be opened from the menu.
Evolution calendar reminders. Only needed if you use Evolution's calendar.
Hands your location to apps that ask. AgentalSec does not use it. Night light's automatic sunset schedule and weather applets may, and would stop finding your location.
Warpinator file sharing on the local network. Only needed to send or receive files with it.
Sticky notes. Only needed if you use them.
Printer queue tray icon. Printing works without it.
Logs which files and apps you use. Nothing needs the log.
Tells you about security updates.
The network icon, where Wi-Fi is chosen.
The Bluetooth icon and pairing.
Part of the Cinnamon desktop.
Stores passwords and keys for other programs.
Asks for your password when a program needs admin rights.
Screen reader, for people who need it.
On-screen keyboard, for people who need it.
File search index. Search stops finding new files without it.
